title: Vladimir Lukich Baranoff

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
Date April 8, 1939
Subject Communication dated 24-3-39 from the British Consulate-General concerning V.L. Baranoff.
Made by J.J.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Gerasimov.

Vladimir Lukich BARANOFF, Russian, born on August 16, 1890 at Tomsk, Siberia. Formerly a junior war time officer in the "White" Russian army in Siberia, he is reported to have left Russia for Manchuria in 1920 together with the remnants of the army. For the following 13 years he resided in Harbin where, according to his own statement, he was employed as a general assistant in the Engineering Department of the Jardine Engineering Corporation, Ltd., for seven years. He arrived in Shanghai from Harbin via Tsingtao in September, 1933. Here he was without regular employment for several months, after which he was engaged as a mechanic(?) by the French Hat Factory, No. 785-707 Yulin Road. Some time during the latter part of 1935 he is reported to have left for the South.

Enquiries at Headquarters of the Shanghai Volunteer Corps show that Baranoff joined the Volunteer Company, Russian Regiment, on 5-3-34 and was struck off the strength of the Corps on 29-1-36 on account of his departure from Shanghai.

Baranoff is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road, on the strength of passport No. 8119 issued on 15-8-33 by the Tsingtao City Government Police Bureau. In his registration form he stated that he was married and that his wife, Mrs Nathalie Alexeyevna PALYSHEFF born 20-8-1903 at Shadrinsk, Russia, was in Harbin at that time.

由 J.J.I. Prokofiev 撰写。由 C. Gerasimov 转呈。

弗拉基米尔·卢基奇·巴拉诺夫（Vladimir Lukich BARANOFF），俄罗斯人，1890年8月16日出生于西伯利亚托木斯克。据报，他曾是西伯利亚“白”俄军队中的一名初级战时军官，并于1920年随该军残部离开俄国前往满洲。在随后的13年里，他居住在哈尔滨，据其自称，他在怡和工程股份有限公司（Jardine Engineering Corporation, Ltd.）工程部担任普通助理达七年之久。他于1933年9月经青岛从哈尔滨抵达上海。在此后的几个月里，他没有固定职业，之后受雇于榆林路785-707号的法国帽厂，担任技工（？）。据报，他在1935年下半年某时前往南方。

向上海万国商团总部查询显示，巴拉诺夫于1934年3月5日加入商团俄罗斯联队志愿连，并因其离开上海而于1936年1月29日从商团名册中除名。

巴拉诺夫凭青岛市政府警察局于1933年8月15日签发的第8119号护照，在莫尔缅路118/1号的俄罗斯侨民委员会进行了登记。在其登记表中，他声明自己已婚，其妻娜塔莉·阿列克谢耶芙娜·帕利舍夫夫人（Mrs Nathalie Alexeyevna PALYSHEFF），1903年8月20日出生于俄罗斯沙德林斯克，当时身在哈尔滨。

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O.BOX 289. SHANGHAI.

24th March, 1939.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 9/07
Date 25 3 '39）

My dear Robertson,

An individual named VLADIMIR LUKITCH BARANOFF
now living in Calcutta has applied for naturalization
as a British subject. In his application he states that he
resided in Shanghai as a mechanical engineer for a period
of nine months from the beginning of April 1934 to the end
of December 1934 and that during this period he was a member
of the Shanghai Volunteer Corps.

I should be very much obliged if you could
inform me whether, during this period, he came to adverse
notice in any way and if you could let me have any
information available about him.

Yours sincerely,
（签名）

T. Robertson, Esq.,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

1939年3月24日。

编号 S. B. D. 9/07
日期 1939年3月25日）

亲爱的罗伯逊：

现居加尔各答的一名名为弗拉基米尔·卢基奇·巴拉诺夫（VLADIMIR LUKITCH BARANOFF）的人士已申请归化为英国臣民。在其申请书中，他声称自1934年4月初至1934年12月底的九个月期间，他以机械工程师身份居住在上海，并且在此期间是上海万国商团的成员。

如蒙告知他在此期间是否曾以任何方式引起负面关注，并提供有关他的任何现有信息，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼，
（签名）

T. Robertson 先生，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

（手写批注：D.S.J. Richardson E 80/3）
